pyproject.toml.purpose: Python package metadata and tool config

safe_patterns: CLI tools discovering config files automatically (pytest, mypy, coverage)
dangerous_patterns: Hardcoded paths like Path('pyproject.toml') (breaks when moved)
Workflow hashFiles() depending on specific root locations
